image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on a purple coneflower. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is uniformly brown with distinct rows of small eyespots (ocelli) featuring white centers and black rings. One clubbed antenna is clearly visible extending upwards. The body appears hairy and brown, blending with the wing coloration. The background consists of soft-focus green foliage and yellow flowers.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: One antenna is clearly visible in profile, showing the characteristic thickening at the tip (club). The second is likely occluded by the angle but the visible one confirms the trait.

The texture of the body is visibly fuzzy/hairy, and the proportions appear slender relative to the wing size.
